source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: As your Command phase ends, if you control an objective marker and this unit stands within range of it, you keep that marker under your control until a phase ends with the opposing player holding a higher Level of Control over it than you.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
